scenario: The ego vehicle travels on a multi-lane road approaching an interchange, where an adversarial car cuts in from the right lane and then exits to the right ramp.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane, then changes to the left lane to avoid the adversarial vehicle.

adversarials.behavior: The car changes from the right lane into the ego lane ahead, then exits to the right ramp.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a multi-lane straight road approaching an interchange with an overpass; an adversarial car starts in the right lane to the right of the ego, moves into the ego lane, and then takes the right exit ramp.
requirements_and_restrictions: Initial distance between the ego and the interchange is defined; the scenario terminates once the ego has passed the interchange or the adversarial vehicle has fully exited.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right side of the road on a pole, displaying directional information above the interchange.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the dashboard-camera vehicle; the white car merging from right is the adversarial. 2. Evidence: adversarial's lateral position shifts from right lane to ego lane then to exit ramp; ego shifts left to avoid.
